abstract: We show that every classifiable stably finite $C^*$-algebra is isomorphic to the $C^*$-algebra of a second countable, locally compact Hausdorff, principal \'etale groupoid. Equivalently, every such $C^*$-algebra has a $C^*$-diagonal whose Weyl twist is trivial. Together with Evington and Sibbel's recent result for all UCT Kirchberg algebras, this provides untwisted principal groupoid models for every classifiable $C^*$-algebra.
hook: Every classifiable stably finite C*-algebra has an untwisted etale groupoid model
summary: The paper shows each such C*-algebra can be written as the algebra of a principal etale groupoid, equivalently that it has a C*-diagonal with trivial Weyl twist. Combined with a recent result for Kirchberg algebras, this covers every classifiable C*-algebra. It is an existence result and does not give an explicit groupoid in each case.
title: Every classifiable stably finite $C^*$-algebra has an untwisted \'etale groupoid model
